in_marathi.name: Shreyvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Prosperity, Victory, Triumph
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shreyvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Shreyvansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shreyas', meaning 'prosperity', and 'van' meaning 'victory' or 'triumph'. This name is often given to a child born into a prosperous family or one who is expected to achieve great success and victory in life.
